sloka: ततः कैलासकूटाभं चतुर्दन्तं मदस्रवम् ।शृङ्गारधारिणं प्रांशुं स्वर्णघण्टाट्टहासिनम् ।। ७.३५.३७ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ kailāsakūṭābhaṁ caturdantaṁ madasravam ।śṛṅgāradhāriṇaṁ prāṁśuṁ svarṇaghaṇṭāṭṭahāsinam ।। 7.35.37 ॥

translations.english: Then (Indra's elephant) appeared, resembling the peak of Kailasa, four-tusked, with ichor flowing, adorned with ornaments, tall, and making a loud sound with its golden bells.
